practicesLabel: Inquiry, Command Terms and HL Extensions
practices: Assessments evaluate core understanding across 4 Themes (A to D) plus all HL Extensions. High emphasis on analytical data questions, experimental evaluation, and higher cognitive command terms like Evaluate, Discuss, and To what extent. Paper 1 requires strong database evaluation; Paper 2 requires detailed long-form structured arguments.

keyTopics: Water structure, cohesive/adhesive properties, hydrogen bonding
Nucleic acid structures, RNA and DNA nucleotides
Cell theory, cell structure, eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells
Origins of cells, endosymbiotic theory (HL Extension)
Diversity of organisms, classification systems, cladistics
Evolutionary lateral gene transfer (HL Extension)
Structure and function of carbohydrates and lipids
Structure and function of proteins, peptide bonds
Membranes and active membrane transport, sodium-potassium pumps (HL Extension)
Organelles and cell compartmentalization
Cell specialization, stem cells
Gas exchange systems, lungs
Transport systems, blood circulation
Muscle and motility, sliding filament theory (HL Extension)
Enzymes and metabolism, active site, factors affecting rates
Cell respiration pathways, ATP yields, oxidative phosphorylation & electron transport chain (HL Extension)
Photosynthesis pathways, light-dependent stage, light-independent reactions/Calvin cycle (HL Extension)
Chemical signaling, receptors, secondary messengers (HL Extension)
Neural signaling, synapses, action potentials
Populations, ecosystems, food webs, communities
DNA replication, semiconservative replication
Protein synthesis, transcription, translation
Gene regulation, transcription factors (HL Extension)
Cell division, mitosis, chromosome replication
Gene transmission, inheritance, monohybrid crosses, gene linkage, polygenic inheritance (HL Extension)
Natural selection, speciation, evolution
Climate change, ecosystem conservation

antiPatterns: Grade strictly according to HL mark schemes. Ensure student shows advanced biochemical understanding. Out of scope are: memorization of historical fossil discovery dates; human-only skeletal joints detailed listing (keep to general muscle mechanics); and structural biochemical molecular detail beyond standard amino acid structures. Evaluative essay style answers must show balanced argumentation.
